paras: Wilson's blind snake (Myriopholis wilsoni) is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is native to Yemen.
The specific name, wilsoni, is in honor of American mammalogist Don Ellis Wilson.
M. wilsoni is endemic to the island of Socotra in Yemen.
The preferred natural habitats of M. wilsoni are forest and shrubland, at altitudes from sea level to 995 m (3,264 ft).
